title: Impact of HPV on a Cohort of Southern Italian Women: Epidemiological, Clinical, Morphological and Microbiological Features
brief_summary: HPV is known to be the causal agent in the majority of cervical cancers. However, the role of the cervical bacterial microbiome in cervical cancer is not clear
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women in fertile age

Exclusion Criteria:

* severe comorbidities
